notes: Read from Zenodo record 18173664 and the authors' README on 2026-10-21 (#44): 803 patients, 1,620 lumbar AP or lateral radiographs as DICOM in eight zips lumos_x_<first>_<last>_dcm.zip (the one named lumos_x_741_670_dcm.zip holds 741 to 770), each lumos_x/lumos_x_<patient>/lumos_x_<patient>_<n>.dcm, patients 001 to 803, beside 280 CTs and an npy zip the bank leaves alone; CC BY-NC 4.0. The X-ray members are read inside the zips, never unpacked a second time. The person is the patient number of the file name, as the README defines it; the view is the header's ViewPosition.
